selected_story.headline: AI agents used in $5,000 cyberattack campaign
selected_story.source_title: Researcher: a Chinese-speaking hacker used AI agents to target 1,200+ websites and breach 100+ entities, including Deere and SharkNinja, spending ~$5,000 total (Raphael Satter/Reuters)

short.title: AI agents used in $5,000 cyberattack campaign
short.description:
It demonstrates that sophisticated, multi-target cyberattacks are becoming alarmingly cheap and accessible, shifting the economics of digital intrusion.

short.script: AI agents used in $5,000 cyberattack campaign. A Chinese-speaking hacker used autonomous AI agents to breach over 100 entities, including Deere and SharkNinja, by targeting exposed instances of the open-source tool Cairn. Read the Sapiver Forge Daily Brief.
